content.short: Ton Raffles is a TON NFT raffle and launchpad platform for raffles, allowlists, discounts, and NFT drops.
content.description: Ton Raffles is an NFT-focused TON platform. TON App describes raffles that can award allowlist spots, discounts, or entire NFTs, while the project docs describe an NFT Launchpad for timed collection sales with round rules, purchase limits, access controls, and custom pricing. It belongs in NFT tooling because it supports both raffle participation and collection launch workflows. Ton Raffles supports NFT activity around discovery, lending, analysis, valuation, or asset management instead of acting only as a marketplace.
